rationale: The previous iteration showed some improvement in progress and RMS error but the robot still failed to complete the tracks, with persistent line loss events and notable steering oscillations. The feedback suggested that the integral gain ki might still be too high, causing oscillations, and that stronger damping via kd could help reduce steering oscillations. Also, increasing the influence of inner sensors by adjusting sensor_weights could improve line detection and reduce line loss events. Therefore, I reduced ki from 0.10 to 0.05 to minimize integral windup and oscillations, increased kd from 0.07 to 0.08 for stronger damping, and adjusted sensor_weights to [-1.0, -0.7, 0.7, 1.0] to increase inner sensor influence. I kept base_speed at 0.13 and kp at 1.1 as these values balance progress and control responsiveness. The geometry remains unchanged as it was balanced and appropriate. I expect these changes to reduce steering oscillations and line loss events, improving completion likelihood and overall stability. The requested measurements will confirm improvements in completion, line_loss_events, rms_error, and steering_oscillation.
